newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates slip below 20 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates slip below 20 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight rates continued their slide on Wednesday, falling as low as 19.50 percent for some deals although the closing was 20 percent.
"Trades were done at 19.50 and 20.50 but most deals were done at 20 percent," said Zsolt Kovari of ING Bank.
"Last week we had the tax payments but now...the market is easing," he said, adding that the levels are "logical to keep".
The interbank rate closed at 21.25 percent on Tuesday, a day after the National Bank of Hungary cut four of its five repo rates by 0.25 percentage points.
